headline: The corridor keeps yesterday's coat.
body: A window is open half an inch and the curtain does not move. Someone has already wiped the table and left the cloth folded twice. The hour arrives without asking to sit.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high pale, cloud like unironed linen

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: two cyclists, one without a bell

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: 09:05 BST, second cup not yet poured
